scope_and_limits: Read-only inspection except this JSON. No builds, tests, app launch, network operation or runtime validation.

Signatures and definition hashes bind this inventory to current inspected worktree source; names/order of 90 frozen-baseline commands are preserved. Additional development component commands are listed separately.
All 90 commands are pub(crate), not a public external library API; type names retain source module imports.
DTO JSON schemas/key mapping, FFI ownership, domain ranges and actual installed behavior need implementation-level review; this inventory does not establish native parity.
Frontend references are lexical source references, not proof that a given path is reachable. Facade categories are proposed boundaries, not implemented routes.

global_facade_contract.identity: Keep the same admitted product host and existing ManagedEngine, profiles, retirement, streams, settings, updater and lifecycle instances; never start a second network owner.
global_facade_contract.admission: Direct pub(crate) calls bypass main.rs invoke_handler migration allowlist and NativeStartup.require_ready. Extract/reuse exactly those checks before native dispatch; keep every function-local permission/lease/confirmation check.
global_facade_contract.calling_convention: An owned AppHandle in an async Rust task may supply State borrows for typed same-binary delegation. Never expose State/AppHandle/WebviewWindow/Rust futures over C ABI. Define bounded request/response buffers, session/request IDs and argument validation.
global_facade_contract.argument_keys: Existing Tauri macro defaults map snake_case Rust parameters to camelCase JS keys. Preserve old IPC and define any separate native wire schema explicitly.
global_facade_contract.work_ownership: Accepted network/profile/handoff work remains host-owned through completion after view close; only cancel work permitted by existing contract. UI detach must not stop VPN.
global_facade_contract.main_thread: MainActor/AppKit: rendering/window/menu publication and explicit Wi-Fi permission. Background: command futures, sync file locks/parsing, native/Keychain RPC, network fetch/controller I/O. Sync Rust declaration does not imply safe MainActor work.
global_facade_contract.events: Provide bounded native equivalents for cfw://page, cfw://engine-event, cfw://engine-snapshot, cfw://settings-changed, cfw://update-available, cfw://connections-snapshot, cfw://log-lines, cfw://stream-error and cfw://shell-error as applicable. Preserve provenance/StreamBinding and stale-generation rejection.
global_facade_contract.secrets: Do not log generic argument envelopes. Preserve credential zeroization, redaction, exact audience/digest receipts, Keychain ownership; source URLs are visible only through explicit profile actions.
global_facade_contract.window_lifecycle: CloseRequested hides main window; Quit/Cmd+Q uses coordinator shutdown; reload refreshes presentation without reinitializing networking. Native full-host equivalence must replace actual main WebviewWindow identity and handoff readiness deliberately.
global_facade_contract.UI_parity: Preserve all nine original pages, placements, menus, dialog/confirmation steps and explicit refusal states. Migrate components in place; generic dispatch or successful screenshots are not functional parity.

reusable_usecases.status: existing serialization and validated mutation orchestration
usable inside commands; sibling facade needs typed wrapper/extraction
existing command-local orchestration; extract, do not duplicate
reuse off-thread reads and exact GC authority
existing UI dispatch and startup allowlist

proposed_batches.boundary: Extract shared admission and bounded typed events before exposing native mutations. Preserve main-window identity, close/hide/reopen, startup readiness and host-owned work.
Original import strip/cards/context menu/editor and credential dialogs using existing repository/profile-change/vault transactions; same menu order and confirmation flows.
All 12 original rows, same Network settings editor, Engine text action, TUN/System Proxy state/retry/cancel, login live state, explicit unsupported controls.
Three original pages; same mode/group/node behavior, offline selection, bounded probes/cancel, provider partial failures and rule ordering.
Original live controls/detail panes, one bounded host stream registry, exact provenance-bound stop and redaction; detaching view leaves VPN alive.
Original preferences, automation, explicit OS prompts, about/update authorization, menu bar/tray, shortcuts/window bounds; no changed updater installation semantics.
Original explicit maintenance entrypoints and signed identity/ticket/receipt/journal/confirmation/recovery proof. Full native-host readiness requires real replacement proof, not forged WebView ack.
